subject: Embeddings pricing for ClearSight — per-vector vs per-token and dimension support
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearsight.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Embedding pricing request (rate card + model/dimension guidance)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this. We're evaluating embeddings for two core use cases at ClearSight: semantic search across customer support articles (~1.2M docs initially) and real-time product recommendations (~100 requests/sec peak). Procurement asked me to get a clean hosted API rate card and a short note on dimension choices (512/1536/3072) and which Redwood embedding models you recommend for each workload.

Two specific asks:
- Do you price embeddings per-vector or per-token (or both)? Please include examples (e.g., 1M docs → X vectors → cost estimate).
- For a 12-month commitment at ~10M vectors/month, what discount tiers do you offer and any onboarding credits?

I've attached the RFP (ClearSight_RFP_Mar2027.pdf) with usage estimates. Can you get a baseline back this week?

Best,
Elaine Park
Head of Data Products
ClearSight Analytics
[attachment: ClearSight_RFP_Mar2027.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedding pricing request (rate card + model/dimension guidance)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear brief and the RFP. Attaching our latest hosted embeddings rate card (redwood_embeds_ratecard_v3.pdf). Quick summary below to get you moving; happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the examples.

Pricing model (hosted API):
- Base billing: per-vector unit for returned embeddings. For clarity we also bill for tokens consumed during ingestion/normalization at a separate per-token rate (usually small relative to per-vector).
- Example (ballpark):
  - redwood-embed-4-small (512-d): $0.0006 per vector; ingestion token charge ~ $0.00002 per token.
  - redwood-embed-8-large (1536-d): $0.0018 per vector; ingestion token charge ~ $0.00003 per token.

Dimension guidance:
- 512-d (embed-4-small): good for broad semantic search and lower storage cost; recommended for initial search indexes.
- 1536-d (embed-8-large): better for fine-grained relevance and recommendation ranking; higher accuracy for product recommendations.
- 3072-d: reserved for specialized high-precision workloads — please advise if you expect heavy ranking with many near-duplicate items.

Volume discounts (hosted):
- Monthly tiers (standard): 0–1M vectors: list; 1M–5M: 10% off list; 5M–20M: 20% off list; 20M+: contact for enterprise pricing.
- For a 12-month committed 10M vectors/month we typically offer an additional negotiated discount and onboarding credits (e.g., 15–25% off list depending on exact commitments + $25k onboarding credit for migrations over 8M vectors).

Other notes:
- Storage/ingestion: vector storage is billed separately if you use Redwood-managed index storage — we can give a storage estimate based on 8 bytes per dimension after quantization.
- Latency SLOs: embed-4-small is typically lower-latency; embed-8-large has slightly higher token generation time.

Attachments: redwood_embeds_ratecard_v3.pdf (detailed per-model per-vector and per-token table).

If you can confirm the primary dimension you want for search vs recommendations (e.g., 512 for search, 1536 for recommendations), I can return a 3-line cost estimate for your RFP numbers by EOD.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_embeds_ratecard_v3.pdf]

From: Elaine Park <elaine@clearsight.ai>

Subject: Re: Embedding pricing request (rate card + model/dimension guidance)

Ben — this is helpful, thanks. A few follow-ups: 

1) For the 10M vectors/month baseline, can you spell out the math both per-vector and per-token (e.g., cost using 512-d at $0.0006 vs 1536-d at $0.0018, plus ingestion token approx)? We want the monthly and annual totals for procurement.
2) For storage billing: we plan to host vectors with Redwood for the first 6 months. Can you give the storage $/GB month estimate you referenced?
3) Is there any difference in model eligibility (some vendors lock higher-dim models to enterprise tiers)? We need to know if embed-8-large is available on hosted plans.

Also procurement wants to see the discount floor if we sign a 12-mo contract with a 10M/mo commit. Is the onboarding credit you mentioned applied against first invoice or billed as a service credit?

Thanks — Elaine

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding ClearSight's follow-up (below). Key asks: 10M vectors/mo, wants per-vector vs per-token math, storage $/GB/mo, and confirmation that embed-8-large is on hosted plans. They also care about onboarding credit and whether it hits invoice or is a line-item credit.

My read: ClearSight is price-sensitive but willing to commit to 12 months for predictable cost. Our standard play: offer 20% off list at 10M with a 12-mo commitment + $25k onboarding credit applied as an invoice credit over the first 2 months. If legal wants to reserve 3072-d for enterprise-only, we should still make embed-8-large available on hosted with a minimum commit (they're fine).

Suggested approval request for sales ops:
- Approve customer-facing math and a one-page commercial term: 12-mo commit, 10M vectors/mo, 20% off list on vectors + ingestion token waiver first month, $25k onboarding credit (invoice credit).
- If procurement pushes for 25% we can escalate to revenue leader.

Marissa — can you produce a short one-pager and updated rate table we can send? Karthik — please confirm storage $/GB/mo for 512/1536 dims (managed storage).

Thanks,
Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearsight.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedding pricing request (rate card + model/dimension guidance)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the quick follow-ups. Per your requests below, here's the explicit math and confirmation of terms so procurement can review.

Assumptions (for math):
- Primary split: Search (512-d) = 1.2M docs → 1.2M vectors/month; Recommendations (1536-d) = 8.8M vectors/month (estimated calls).
- List prices (hosted): 512-d (embed-4-small) = $0.0006/vector; 1536-d (embed-8-large) = $0.0018/vector. Ingestion tokens charged at $0.000025/token (estimate 1.2 tokens per short doc on average).

Monthly cost (list):
- 512-d: 1.2M * $0.0006 = $720
- 1536-d: 8.8M * $0.0018 = $15,840
- Ingestion tokens (search corpus normalization): assume 1.5M tokens * $0.000025 = $37.50
- Total monthly list = $16,597.50 → Annual list ~ $199,170

Discounted scenario (12-mo commit, 10M vectors/mo):
- Volume discount + committed discount applied: 20% off vectors (applies to both dims) + ingestion token waiver for month 1 + $25,000 onboarding invoice credit applied across first 2 invoices.
- Monthly after 20%: $13,278 (monthly) → Annual committed run-rate = $159,336 before onboarding credit.
- After applying $25k onboarding credit across first two invoices: first two invoices net ~$ (13,278*2 - 25,000) ≈ $1,556; subsequent 10 invoices at $13,278.

Storage (Redwood-managed vectors):
- Storage estimate (post-quantization): ~4 bytes * dimensions per vector. Practical numbers: 512-d → ~2MB per 1k vectors ≈ 2GB per 1M vectors. Our managed storage pricing: $0.10/GB/month (512-d), $0.28/GB/month (1536-d after quant overhead). For 1.2M 512-d + 8.8M 1536-d: storage ~ (1.2*2GB) + (8.8*6GB) ≈ 55.2GB → ~$5.52/month. We'll include a detailed storage calc in the one-pager.

Model eligibility: embed-8-large is available on hosted plans; 3072-d variants are enterprise-only and not typically exposed on self-serve.

Commercial terms (proposed):
- 12-month term, committed 10M vectors/month.
- 20% off list for vectors; ingestion token waiver for month 1.
- $25,000 onboarding credit applied as invoice credit across first two invoices.
- Redwood-managed storage charges billed monthly as above.

Next steps:
- If that looks OK, we'll send a one-page commercial summary + SOW (attached SOW_Clearsight_Onboarding.docx) and a DocuSign link for execution.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if procurement wants to run through the numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
